title: Graph inequality on a single null-measurable L-Lipschitz graph piece, for arbitrary [0,∞]-valued integrands
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, P ∈ G(N,n) with orthogonal projection p := Grassmannian.project P, L ≥ 0, A ⊆ ℝ^N an L-Lipschitz graph over P (|(y − z) − p(y − z)| ≤ L|p(y − z)| for all y, z ∈ A) that is H^n-null-measurable, H^n = μHE[n], and g : ℝ^N → [0,∞] arbitrary (not necessarily measurable). Then ∫⁻_A g dH^n ≤ (1 + L²)^{n/2} ∫⁻_{P.plane} (Σ_{y∈A, p(y)=a} g(y)) dH^n(a), where ∫⁻ is the lower Lebesgue integral and the inner sum is the [0,∞]-valued sum (tsum) of g over the subtype {y : y ∈ A ∧ p(y) = a}.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → ∫⁻ y in A, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + L ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) * ∫⁻ a in (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), (∑' y : {y : Euclidean N // y ∈ A ∧ Grassmannian.project P y = a}, g y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
